svg.title: D15 Rental step 15 · Owner: rental map

g.text: Self-drive rental, step by step (renter, owner and administrator)

text.tspan: Prototype: SMS/email and the GCash gateway are not connected.
Where your rented-out vehicles are right now. The renter’s phone shares the location while driving, as the rental contract requires. You can see it
only between release and return; ZamMove deletes the trail when the vehicle comes back.

g.text: The owner follows each rented-out vehicle on a
live map with its recent route, pickup and
return points. Leaving Zamboanga City turns the
marker red and notifies the owner.
ZAM 5150 driven by Carla, heading towards Pasonanca.
